## Description

This vignette reports the results of another perturbation analyses, *not* run in the previous vignettes, which was built on the same models as in [Single VR Model](DIPM-040_Single_vr_model.html), but where the IPM was run with limits from -500 to 500, with increments of 1 (`n. bins = 1000`), and for 36 months. This perturbation is too time consuming (~ 3h) to be rendered as a vignette efficiently. I will run here the IPMs with these kernel specifications and number of iterations, but will then load the results of the perturbation analyses stored in the folder `results_tokeep`.

## Setup

Loading data, packages, and models.

```{r}
# packages
library(whereipm)
library(tidyverse)

# data
data <- ipmdata %>%
  filter(sex == "F", habitat == "P")

# models
singleVRModels <- readRDS(file.path(here::here(), "results", "singleVRModels.rds"))

# colors
Cols <- wesanderson::wes_palette("Zissou1", 3, type = "continuous")[3:1]
```

### Parameters and initial Population

Here we define kernel parameters and initial population size;

```{r}
# kernel parameters
kp <- create.kernel.params(L=-500, U=500, n.bins = 1000)
# initial population size
pop0 <- c(rep(0, kp$n.bins/2-2), rep(5,3), rep(0, kp$n.bins/2-1))
```

and here, the vital rate parameters;

```{r, results = "asis"}
# First I need to extract the info in the model to make it easier to handle
Models <- singleVRModels %>%
  transmute(
    survival = map(survival, broom::tidy),
    recruit = map(recruitment, broom.mixed::tidy),
    adDispersal = map(adDispersal, broom::tidy),
    adDistance = map(adDistance, broom::tidy),
    natDispersal = map(natDispersal, broom::tidy),
    natDistance = map(natDistance, broom::tidy))

# Storing values into 3 vital params lists, at different time points (start, mid, end)
# given local density is scaled (but not centered) the estimates for the slope have to be transformed back to the non-scaled value.

# Using a general loop to do so for the three phases:

pickedTimes <- c(0, 30, 60)
for(i in pickedTimes){

  temp.vp <- list(# Survival
                 s.int = (Models$survival[[1]]%>%
                   filter(term == "(Intercept)") %>%
                   pull(estimate)) + # true intercept
                   returnIfExists(Models$survival[[1]]%>%
                   filter(term == "s_time") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/scalingAttr$time$scale), # time intercept
                 s.slo = (Models$survival[[1]]%>%
                   filter(term == "s_loc_density") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/scalingAttr$loc_density$scale + # true slope
                   returnIfExists(Models$survival[[1]]%>%
                   filter(term == "s_time:s_loc_density") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/(scalingAttr$time$scale*scalingAttr$loc_density$scale)), # time contribution,
                 s.slo2 = returnIfExists(Models$survival[[1]]%>%
                   filter(term == "I(s_loc_density^2)") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/scalingAttr$loc_density$scale + # quadratic effect
                   returnIfExists(Models$survival[[1]]%>%
                   filter(term == "s_time:I(s_loc_density^2)") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/(scalingAttr$loc_density$scale*scalingAttr$time$scale)),
                 s.multiplier = 1,
                 
                # Recruitment
                 r.int = Models$recruit[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          component == "zi",
                          term == "(Intercept)") %>%
                   pull(estimate) + # true intercept
                  returnIfExists(Models$recruit[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          component == "zi",
                          term == "s_time") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/scalingAttr$time$scale), # time intercept 
                 r.slo = (Models$recruit[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          component == "zi",
                          term == "s_loc_density") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/scalingAttr$loc_density$scale + # true slope
                  returnIfExists(Models$recruit[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          component == "zi",
                          term == "s_time:s_loc_density") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/(scalingAttr$loc_density$scale*scalingAttr$time$scale)), # time interaction
                 r.multiplier = 1,
                
                 f.int = Models$recruit[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          component == "cond",
                          term == "(Intercept)") %>%
                   pull(estimate) +                        # true intercept
                  returnIfExists(Models$recruit[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          component == "cond",
                          term == "s_time") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/scalingAttr$time$scale), # time intercept
                 f.slo = (Models$recruit[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          component == "cond",
                          term == "s_loc_density") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/scalingAttr$loc_density$scale + # true slope
                  returnIfExists(Models$recruit[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          component == "cond",
                          term == "s_time:s_loc_density") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/(scalingAttr$time$scale*scalingAttr$loc_density$scale)), # time interaction
                 f.distribution = 'ztpoisson',
                 
                # Adult dispersal
                 p.stat.int.ad = Models$adDispersal[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "(Intercept)") %>%
                   pull(estimate) + # true intercept
                  returnIfExists(Models$adDispersal[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_time") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/scalingAttr$time$scale), # time intercept
                 p.stat.slo.ad = (Models$adDispersal[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_loc_density") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/scalingAttr$loc_density$scale + # true slope
                  returnIfExists(Models$adDispersal[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_time:s_loc_density") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/(scalingAttr$loc_density$scale*scalingAttr$time$scale)), # time interaction
                 sigma.stat.ad = 0.25, 
                 mu.mob.int.ad = Models$adDistance[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "(Intercept)") %>%
                   pull(estimate) + # true intercept
                  returnIfExists(Models$adDistance[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_time") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/scalingAttr$time$scale), #time intercept
                 mu.mob.slo.ad = returnIfExists(Models$adDistance[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_loc_density") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                 sigma.mob.ad = Models$adDistance[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "ran_pars") %>%
                   pull(estimate) %>%
                   sum %>%
                   sqrt,
                 
                # Natal dispersal
                 p.stat.int.nat = Models$natDispersal[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "(Intercept)") %>%
                   pull(estimate) +                       # true intercept
                  returnIfExists(Models$natDispersal[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_time.birth") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/scalingAttr$time$scale),   # time intercept
                 p.stat.slo.nat = (Models$natDispersal[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_loc_density.mid") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                 p.stat.sloLand.nat = returnIfExists(Models$natDispersal[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_land_density.mid") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/scalingAttr$land_density$scale,
                 p.stat.sloInt.nat = returnIfExists(Models$natDispersal[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_loc_density.mid:s_land_density.mid") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/(scalingAttr$loc_density$scale*scalingAttr$land_density$scale),
                 sigma.stat.nat = 0.25, 
                 mu.mob.int.nat = Models$natDistance[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "(Intercept)") %>%
                   pull(estimate) +                           # true intercept
                  returnIfExists(Models$natDistance[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_time.birth") %>%
                   pull(estimate))*(i/scalingAttr$time$scale), # time intercept
                 mu.mob.slo.nat = returnIfExists(Models$natDistance[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_loc_density.mid") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/scalingAttr$loc_density$scale,
                 mu.mob.sloLand.nat = returnIfExists(Models$natDistance[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_land_density.mid") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/scalingAttr$land_density$scale,
                 mu.mob.sloInt.nat = returnIfExists(Models$natDistance[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "fixed",
                          term == "s_loc_density.mid:s_land_density.mid") %>%
                   pull(estimate))/(scalingAttr$loc_density$scale*scalingAttr$land_density$scale),
                 sigma.mob.nat = Models$natDistance[[1]]%>%
                   filter(effect == "ran_pars") %>%
                   pull(estimate) %>%
                   sum %>%
                   sqrt)
 
  ### there should be no empty values. let's check
  stopifnot(all(lapply(temp.vp, function(x)length(x)==0)==FALSE))
  
  # renaming list
  assign(paste("vp.t", i, sep = ""), temp.vp)
}
```

The parameters stored here are the same as in IPM: single model, so they can be visualised [here](DIPM-050_IPM_single_model.html).

## Running IPMs

The run time here is 36 months.

```{r}
# running IPM
start <- Sys.time()
IPM.init <- runIPM(kp, vp.t0, init.pop = pop0, niter=36)
init.t <- Sys.time() - start
print(init.t)

start <- Sys.time()
IPM.middle <- runIPM(kp, vp.t30, init.pop = pop0, niter=36)
middle.t <- Sys.time() - start
print(middle.t)

start <- Sys.time()
IPM.end <- runIPM(kp, vp.t60, init.pop = pop0, niter=36)
end.t <- Sys.time() - start
print(end.t)
```

To make life easier later, I store here the models in a tibble, and obtain the output variables from these IPMs.

```{r}
# collecting all model outputs in a tibble
singleModelIPMs_long <- tibble(phase = list("init", "middle", "end"),
                          vital.params = list(vp.t0, vp.t30, vp.t60),
                          IPMs = list(IPM.init, IPM.middle, IPM.end),
                          timetorun = list(init.t, middle.t, end.t))

singleModelIPMs_long <- singleModelIPMs_long %>%
  mutate(
    orig.output =   map(IPMs, function(x){
                                speed = x[["speed"]]
                                acceleration = x[["acceleration"]]
                                lambda = sum(x[["pop.size"]][,x[["n.iterations"]]+1])/
                                  sum(x[["pop.size"]][,x[["n.iterations"]]])
                                popCore = x[["pop.size"]][x[["kernel.params"]][["n.bins"]]/2,
                                      x[["n.iterations"]]+1]
                                return = c(speed, acceleration, lambda, popCore)
                                }
                        )
    )
```

## Plotting

### IPM results

```{r}
plotly::plot_ly(x=1:ncol(IPM.init$pop.size), 
                y=rev(kp$y), 
                z=IPM.init$pop.size, 
                type="contour", 
                colorscale = 'Jet', # or use colors = with RColorBrewer values
                autocontour = F,
                contours = list(start = 0, 
                                end = 28,
                                size = 2))
plotly::plot_ly(x=1:ncol(IPM.middle$pop.size),
                y=rev(kp$y),
                z=IPM.middle$pop.size,
                type="contour", colorscale = 'Jet',
                autocontour = F,
                contours = list(start = 0, 
                                end = 28,
                                size = 2))
plotly::plot_ly(x=1:ncol(IPM.end$pop.size),
                y=rev(kp$y),
                z=IPM.end$pop.size,
                type="contour", colorscale = 'Jet',
                autocontour = F,
                contours = list(start = 0, 
                                end = 28,
                                size = 2))

quick.plot(IPM.init, "Init")
quick.plot(IPM.middle, "Middle")
quick.plot(IPM.end, "End")
```

### Comparing output variables

I am here plotting the output variables from the three IPMs (lambda, core population size, speed and acceleration).

```{r, fig.height = 7}
# and the list of output variables
output <- c('speed', 'acceleration', 'lambda', 'pop')

# extracting original parameters and reading them for plotting
outputs <- singleModelIPMs_long %>%
  select(orig.output) %>%
  pull() %>%
  unlist() %>%
  matrix(ncol = nrow(singleModelIPMs_long), nrow = length(output)) %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame()
colnames(outputs) <- c('speed', 'acc', 'lambda', 'pop')

# plotting
par(mfrow = c(2,2))
# Lambda
plot(outputs$lambda, type='l', main='Lambda', ylim = c(1, 1.1), xlim = c(0.7, 3.3), 
     xaxt = 'n', ylab = '', xlab = '', las = 1)
axis(1, at = 1:3, labels = c('Initial', 'Middle', 'End'), las=1)
points(outputs$lambda, col = Cols, pch=19, cex = 1.5)
text(1:3, outputs$lambda*0.99, labels = round(as.numeric(outputs$lambda), 2), cex = 1)
mtext(expression(lambda), 2, line = 2.5, las = 1)

# Core population
plot(outputs$pop, type='l', main='Core population size', xaxt = 'n', ylab = '', xlim = c(0.7, 3.3), xlab = '', ylim = c(0, 35), las = 1)
points(outputs$pop, col = Cols, pch=19, cex = 1.5)
text(1:3, outputs$pop - 4, labels = round(as.numeric(outputs$pop), 0), cex = 1)
axis(1, at = c(1,2,3), labels = c("Initial","Middle", "Late"), las=1)
mtext('N', 2, line = 2.5, las = 1)

# Speed
plot(outputs$speed, type='l', main='Speed at the front', ylim = c(-1,30), xaxt = 'n', xlim = c(.7, 3.3), xlab = '', ylab = '')
points(outputs$speed, col = Cols, pch=19, cex = 1.5)
axis(1, at = c(1,2,3), labels = c("Init", 'Middle', 'End'), las=1)
text(1:3, outputs$speed + 2, labels = round(as.numeric(outputs$speed), 2), cex = 1)
mtext('m/month', 2, line = 2.5)

# Acceleration
plot(outputs$acc, type='l', ylim = c(0,1), main='Acceleration', xaxt = 'n', xlim = c(.7, 3.3), xlab = '', ylab = '')
axis(1, at = c(1,2,3), labels = c('Initial', 'Middle', 'End'), las=1)
points(outputs$acc, col = Cols, pch=19, cex = 1.5)
text(1:3, outputs$acc + 0.1, labels = round(as.numeric(outputs$acc), 2), cex = 1)
mtext(expression(m/month^2), 2, line = 2.5)
```

### Plotting perturbation results

Here, I am not running the perturbation analyses (too time consuming), but rather loading a stored perturbation result.

First, loading the perturbation results and rearranging the format to make it easier to plot.

```{r}
perturbationResults_long <- readRDS(file.path(here::here(),
                                              "results_tokeep",
                               "perturbation_result_single_model_K1000x36.rds"))

# For ease of plotting, handling the array t make it a single data.frame with outputs for columns and parameters for rows
pResults_long <- aperm(perturbationResults_long, perm = c(2,1,3))
pResults_long <- data.frame(apply(pResults_long, 2, c),
                       expand.grid(dimnames(perturbationResults_long)[c(2,3)]))
colnames(pResults_long)[(ncol(pResults_long)-1):ncol(pResults_long)] <- c("params", "phase")
```

Now, ready for plotting.

```{r}
# creating a vector of better names for parameteres
paramnames <- c('survival (int)', 'survival (slo)', 'survival (quad)',
            'repr p (int)',  'repr p (slo)', 
            'offspr n (int)',  'offspr n (slo)',
            'ad dispersal (int)','ad dispersal (slo)', 
            'ad distance (mean)', 'ad distance (sd)',
            'nat dispersal (int)','nat dispersal (slo)',
            'nat dispersal (landsc)', 'nat dispersal (loc x land)',
            'nat distance (mean)', 'nat distance (sd)')

## plotting all outputs
for(i in output){
  p <- ggplot(data = pResults_long, aes_string(x = "params", y = i, fill = "phase")) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.8, position = position_dodge()) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = Cols) +
  theme_minimal()
print(p + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -45)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = paramnames) +
  ggtitle(as.character(i)))
}


```
